regions.label: INESHeader
regions.evidence: Validated iNES signature and mapper/PRG/CHR sizes; workspace inspection.

regions.label: CHRTilePatterns
regions.evidence: iNES CHR ROM section: 8192 16-byte NES 2bpp tile patterns, immutable PPU pattern storage separate from CPU PRG; startup renders these patterns.

regions.label: PasswordAlphabetGlyphs
regions.evidence: Password input consumer at physical$16985..169A7 computes row*10+column, stores compact index at$05A0,X and reads glyph table CPU$AACF,Y into$0580,X; 64-symbol password alphabet ends before known next routine. Complete alphabet format and exact bytes/bounds inspected in password-contract-0x16980.json and final-password-recipe.json. Final-game password accepted after index/glyph injection; semantic use observed, complete extent static.

regions.label: MatchPhaseDispatchWords
regions.evidence: Validated match dispatcher physical$18022..18032 doubles substate$6C, loads little-endian word from CPU$8023/$8024 and JMP($002A). Table begins immediately after terminal indirect jump and ends at observed first handler physical$18045/CPU$8035. Nine complete words all point within same bank12 window; multiple handlers observed in match scenarios. Exact words and consumer in analysis/evidence/match-phase-table.json; static extent distinct from natural selector reachability.

regions.label: InvalidSelectorTrap
regions.evidence: Rooted official control flow LDA$AD/CMP#3/BCC$99CE falls through to one-byte BRK at$99CD only for invalid selector>=3; branch target skips this exact trap byte to next valid routine sequence. BRK invokes validated IRQ/reset vector $FFD8. This independent control-flow/exception contract supports static code; natural trap reachability unresolved. Initially withheld during static-final review, corrected after separating structural role from fetch evidence; static-final-new.json preserves exact source.

regions.label: IRQResetEntry
regions.evidence: Validated immutable IRQ/BRK vector at physical$2000E names CPU$FFD8 in fixed PRG15. Exact stub INC$FFD0/JMP$C000 matches reset stub contract: MMC1 reset write followed by fixed-bank reset dispatch. Bank0/1 view is supported reset-context alias; fixed banks14/15 resolve all stub and destination bytes. Natural IRQ/BRK entry not observed; structural hardware-vector contract is static.
